item.description: ### Fixed - **Codex: sessions no longer disappear after 30 minutes idle.** Since Codex 0.157, sessions run in Codex's background service by default, and Perch dropped an idle one from the list after half an hour even with its terminal still open. It now stays as long as the session is open. - **Codex: the phone says why it can't reply to a session in Codex's background service,** instead of suggesting tmux. Start Codex with `--no-daemon` to get replies and Stop back while Perch learns the new setup.
